scope: Numerical verification only; no empirical corpus validation

added_rules.statement: Identify the transport S/u with the momentum S/u across separate corpus sections.
added_rules.scope: Proposed in Miro frame 13 as a dashed coupling; implemented in the solver. It is a model assembly choice, not an empirically established link.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Periodic two-dimensional unit square, uniform grid, unit area.
added_rules.scope: Implemented. These are mathematical coordinates, not measured mental locations; no three-dimensional generality is claimed. Mean S equals integral S only because the area is one.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Constant coefficients and fixed source location x0=(.5,.5). Default forcing direction e_k=(1,0).
added_rules.scope: Implemented. No observed role/source location or direction was calibrated.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Specific kernel K proportional to exp{[cos(2pi(x−.5))+cos(2pi(y−.5))−2]/(2pi h)^2}, normalized by its grid mean.
added_rules.scope: Implemented. The register specifies a normalized localized kernel, not this functional shape. The Fourier representation then truncates this kernel.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: State represented by two velocity components and one signed scalar field; pressure reconstructed with mean zero.
added_rules.scope: Implemented. Pressure's zero mean is a gauge choice. No independent Smoke or Clay state is present.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Fourier spatial differentiation and Galerkin truncation, retaining only modes with 3|m_x|<n and 3|m_y|<n.
added_rules.scope: Implemented to control aliasing. This changes the finite numerical representation, not the written continuum equations.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Helmholtz projection of velocity right-hand side and post-step projection to remove roundoff divergence. Preserve velocity zero mode.
added_rules.scope: Implemented incompressibility treatment.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Classical fourth-order Runge–Kutta time integration. U is constant on each supplied interval; A advances at every intermediate stage.
added_rules.scope: Implemented. Piecewise-constant input is an interpolation assumption, not a corpus requirement.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Time-step cap .45/[max(nu,D)*max(1,max retained k²)]. Steps=ceil(duration/min(requested_dt,cap)); actual_dt=duration/steps.
added_rules.scope: Implemented numerical choice. Requested halving is not necessarily actual halving; actual steps must be checked. This diffusion cap is not a general proof of nonlinear stability.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Initial u=v[sin(2pi x)cos(2pi y),−cos(2pi x)sin(2pi y)]; S=M0+b cos(2pi x)cos(2pi y).
added_rules.scope: Implemented initializer. Shape, texture b and speed v are synthetic assumptions, not measured person states.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Default numerical coefficients: n=24, nu=.02, D=.01, rho=1, sigma=.1, Gamma=.05, epsilon=.1, h=.12, gamma=kappa=1, Ubaseline=0, raw gradient, delta=.01. Default texture=.04, speed=.1 and total S=0.
added_rules.scope: Code defaults; actual runners override some. mu0 has no accepted implicit default in the audited wrapper. None is a measured psychological constant.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Explicit person ID, event reference, initial-history basis, Astart, start time and requested step required. Role must be Smoke/Clay/both/unattributed.
added_rules.scope: Added provenance contract. Role membership changes metadata only; swapping Smoke/Clay leaves equations unchanged.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Refuse cross-person joins, interval gaps/overlaps, missing/nonfinite U or time and nonpositive duration/step. Contiguity tolerance 1e−12.
added_rules.scope: Added input policy. Missing history is not set to zero. The policy rejects unknown intervals; it does not reconstruct their history.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Even integer grid n>=12; finite coefficients; nu>0, D>=0, rho>0, sigma>=0, Gamma>=0, h>0, mu0>0, epsilon>0, delta>0; two-component finite direction with approximately unit norm.
added_rules.scope: Implemented parameter-domain restrictions. Unit norm uses NumPy `isclose` defaults (rtol=1e−5, atol=1e−8), not exact symbolic equality. Gamma here means threshold; gamma input-gain remains finite without a positivity guard.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Initial spectral shape (3,n,n), resolved modes, real physical field and divergence-free velocity checked to 1e−10.
added_rules.scope: Added finite precision acceptance policy. Finite output is checked during evolution.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Mass, pressure/stress/velocity RMS, kinetic energy, force work, viscous dissipation and divergence are diagnostics. Mass uses the exact interval integral kappa[Astart dt + gamma DeltaU dt²/2].
added_rules.scope: Derived diagnostic consequences, not independent empirical measurements. Energy is .5 mean|u|²; work=mean(u·f), viscous loss=nu mean|grad u|².
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Grid comparison uses Fourier coefficients normalized by n², retaining common modes; RMS discrepancy is sqrt(sum|difference|²).
added_rules.scope: Existing audit comparison rule; does not itself measure unresolved high-frequency error.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Actual refinement requires same observation times and strictly smaller actual steps with more steps in each interval.
added_rules.scope: Added verification rule.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Existing synthetic audit: grids24,48,72; requested dt=.001 plus an actual-half-step run; all three activations; M0=.3,Astart=.2,mu0=.07; U=+1 then−1 over two .125 intervals; swapped role labels; S+10 offset.
added_rules.scope: Already executed earlier. These inputs are numerical fixtures, not real people. Test acceptance includes <1e−12 conservation/energy/divergence checks, analytic solution atol=1e−11 and decreasing successive grid discrepancy.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement

added_rules.statement: Separate Miro alternatives: A'=gamma DeltaU−lambda A and/or S relaxation −mu S, checked through [A,M,1] matrix exponentials with lambda or mu=1 and finite ±1 pulses.
added_rules.scope: Already checked as alternatives in the previous audit. These added equations are not inserted into the unchanged corpus solver and are not validated forgetting laws.
added_rules.origin: Added numerical/assembly/verification choice; not a corpus requirement
